name: dialogue-box
description: macOS only. /dialogue on: talk with Claude by voice. Speech leads and the written reply becomes a board it points at (or a full reply it sums up). A local neural voice through voxlektor on Apple Silicon (gapless, several sessions take turns), or Microsoft Edge neural voices via edge-tts, with your Mac's voices as backup, in a dialogue box you can rewind, pause, skip and speed up.
